meaning: Tub Clean reminder: it is time to run the Tub Clean cycle. This is a maintenance reminder, not a fault.
causes: The washer is prompting you to run the monthly Tub Clean cycle
diySteps: Empty the tub and pour in powder washing machine cleaner (sold near the detergent in most retail stores)
Power the washer on, turn the knob to Tub Clean (or press the Tub Clean button) and start the cycle
To skip it, turn the cycle selector knob or press the option buttons to choose another cycle. The tCL message can continue for a few cycles
Run Tub Clean monthly to keep it from coming back
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: No repair needed; the message clears once Tub Clean has been run.
sourceTitle: LG Front Load Washer – Error Code List (LG USA Support)
